plain: In an election, more votes than any other candidate, but not more than half

webster.text: A number consisting of two or more of the same kind; as a plurality of gods; a plurality of worlds.

more.text: In elections, a plurality of votes is when one candidate has more votes than any other, but less than half of the whole number of votes given.
Plurality of benefices, is where the same clerk is possessed of more benefices than one, with cure of souls.

example.quote: When a choice is made by a plurality of votes, it is often made by a very small part of the electors, who attend and give their votes, when by a majority, never by so few as one half of them.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XII, Jan. 12, 1788
